description: This file defines a PHP interface for token parsers in the Twig templating engine, specifying methods for setting a parser, parsing tokens into nodes, and retrieving the tag name.

methods.name: setParser
methods.description: Associates a parser instance with this token parser.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a given token and returns a corresponding node, potentially throwing a SyntaxError.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name associated with this token parser.
